fusions.name: Needle Through a Keyhole
fusions.desc: A precise thrust that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Blade-Glint
fusions.desc: Flashes light from the blade at the first enemy within 7 tiles: it deals 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spellbreaker's Return
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Marked Beforehand
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
